entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought recently. I'd like to see about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you finding it's a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's definitely a preference thing. I've read the user manual a couple of times, but I just find the menu system very confusing. It's much harder to use than I thought it would be.
I'm sorry to hear it's not as intuitive as you'd hoped.

Yeah, I just expected more from the interface. I know I'm a little past the 10-day mark, but since it's not damaged, would it be possible to get a partial credit or maybe a discount code for a different model?
Let me just pull up your account to check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like it was delivered 12 days ago, on December 30th.
Right, that's what I thought. So, what are my options?
Actually, you're perfectly fine. Our VeloFit return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery. You are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? Ninety days? I thought I saw a special condition for the Pulse models. That's fantastic news.

My system confirms it's the standard 90-day policy. I have just processed and approved the return for you. I'm emailing the pre-paid shipping label to you right now. You should receive it in the next 5 minutes.
Wow, that was surprisingly simple. Thank you very much for your help, Diana.
You're most welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
